title: Section 8 — Save configuration
description: Game settings and modifiers. Holds a single entry. saveDisplayName is set from the merge function parameter.

saveDisplayName.description: Display name of the save (merge function parameter)

unlockedOreExtrators.description: Ore extractors unlocked (game typo kept as is)

preInterplanetarySave.description: Save created before the interplanetary system was introduced

modifierTerraformationPace.description: Terraformation speed multiplier (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0; 1.0 = normal)

modifierPowerConsumption.description: Energy consumption multiplier (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0; 1.0 = normal)

modifierGaugeDrain.description: Player gauge depletion multiplier (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0; 1.0 = normal)

modifierMeteoOccurence.description: Weather event frequency multiplier (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0; 1.0 = normal)

modifierMultiplayerTerraformationFactor.description: Terraformation contribution factor in multiplayer (Unity float — serialized with a trailing .0)

modded.description: The game was played with mods enabled

version.description: Game version at the time of the save (e.g. '1.618')

hasPlayedIntro.description: The intro cinematic has already been played

gameStartLocation.description: Initial location of the player at the start of the game
